name: price-tag
title: Price Tag
description: Locale-aware price with compare-at strike, computed discount badge and a screen-reader announcement. No dependencies.
author: ecomcn <hello@ecomcn.dev>

name: product-card
title: Product Card
description: Catalogue tile with badges, compare-at pricing, colour swatches that swap the image, rating and a keyboard-reachable quick-add. Compound: use it as one tag, or recompose it from ProductCardMedia, ProductCardBody and their parts via useProductCard().
author: ecomcn <hello@ecomcn.dev>

name: product-grid
title: Product Grid
description: Responsive catalogue grid with box-matched loading skeletons, appended skeletons while more results load, a density switch, a renderCard slot for composed cards, and a left-aligned empty state.
author: ecomcn <hello@ecomcn.dev>

name: sort-toolbar
title: Sort Toolbar
description: The rule above a listing: a result count announced to screen readers once results settle, a native sort select, a density switch and a slot for the mobile filter trigger.
author: ecomcn <hello@ecomcn.dev>

name: empty-results
title: Empty Results
description: A no-match state that names the filters that emptied the grid, offers the single change that brings the most back, and lets shoppers remove filters one at a time. Left-aligned, never centred.
author: ecomcn <hello@ecomcn.dev>

name: filter-panel
title: Filter Panel
description: Faceted filters with state that lives in the URL: applied-filter chips, checkbox lists with counts, a dual-handle range with typed inputs, colour swatches and toggles. Compound: one tag for the default layout, or FilterPanelHeader, FilterPanelChips and FilterPanelFacet in any order via useFilterPanel(). Ships a pure parser for server components and a useFilterParams hook.
author: ecomcn <hello@ecomcn.dev>

name: filter-sheet
title: Filter Sheet
description: The filter panel in a slide-over for small screens. Changes are staged and applied once — on Show or on close — with a live result count on the button and focus returned to the trigger. Accepts the same FilterPanel parts as children, so a custom layout stages too.
author: ecomcn <hello@ecomcn.dev>

name: load-more
title: Load More
description: Progressive loading for a product list: a progress rule and “Showing 24 of 312” count, a Load more button, optional hybrid or infinite auto-loading, focus moved to the first new item, and an announced count. The pattern Baymard found performs best, in one component.
author: ecomcn <hello@ecomcn.dev>

name: product-quick-view
title: Product Quick View
description: Quick view with a shared-element morph: the card image grows into the dialog and shrinks back on close. Motion's layoutId drives the morph, a native <dialog> does the modal work, focus returns to the trigger, and reduced-motion users get no movement. The one ecomcn block that depends on motion — opt-in.
author: ecomcn <hello@ecomcn.dev>

name: order-summary
title: Order Summary
description: Free-shipping progress, promo code field with applied state, itemised totals and the checkout CTA. Totals logic lives in a separate hook you can test.
author: ecomcn <hello@ecomcn.dev>

name: theme-editorial
title: Editorial Theme
description: The ecomcn house style — warm paper, near-black ink, a single vermilion signal colour, and a 2px radius so nothing reads as a rounded card. Ships the complete shadcn token set plus --brand, --sale and --success.
author: ecomcn <hello@ecomcn.dev>
